tagline: The world's coldest capital — a Soviet-bloc skyline beside gers and monasteries, gateway to the endless steppe.
overview: Ulaanbaatar is the world's coldest capital — winter nights drop below -30°C — and one of its strangest: Soviet apartment blocks stand beside white gers (yurts), a monastery ringed by prayer wheels, and a skyline that appeared in a single nomadic century.
Sükhbaatar Square anchors the centre beneath a giant Chinggis Khan statue, and the Gandan Monastery's 26-metre gold Buddha keeps the country's Buddhist heart beating after decades of suppression.

Speed's 2025 tour streamed from Ulaanbaatar — the Mongolia episode became a fan favourite for the horse culture and sheer strangeness. The real destination is out the window: the steppe, the Gobi and nomad camps begin where the roads end.

funFacts.title: WORLD'S COLDEST CAPITAL
funFacts.text: Winters drop below -40°C — the coldest capital city on earth.

funFacts.title: HALF THE COUNTRY
funFacts.text: Around half of Mongolia's 3.4 million people live in Ulaanbaatar.

funFacts.title: THE GER DISTRICTS
funFacts.text: Yurt neighbourhoods spread across the hillsides — nomads who settled.

funFacts.title: THE GIANT BUDDHA
funFacts.text: Gandan's Migjid Janraisig statue stands 26.5m — rebuilt after Soviet destruction.

funFacts.title: CHINGGIS SQUARE
funFacts.text: Sükhbaatar Square's marble palace holds a seated Genghis Khan statue.

funFacts.title: THE 40-METRE KHAN
funFacts.text: A 40m stainless Genghis on horseback — the world's largest equestrian statue — stands an hour east.

funFacts.title: RED HERO
funFacts.text: 'Ulaanbaatar' means Red Hero — the name dates to 1924.

funFacts.title: AIR POLLUTION CRISIS
funFacts.text: Winter coal-smoke from the ger districts makes it among the world's most polluted capitals.

funFacts.title: NAADAM
funFacts.text: July's festival of wrestling, horse racing and archery is the national holiday.

funFacts.title: GOBI GATEWAY
funFacts.text: The desert's dinosaur cliffs and singing dunes start a day's drive south.
